question: In which budget was the policy of LERMS announced?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1992-1993.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Liberalized Exchange Rate Management System:**

 
• LERMS (Liberalized Exchange Rate Management System) was a **new exchange rate management system.**
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI) purchased 40 per cent of the proceeds of exports and inward remittances at the official exchange rate** for official use under this scheme.
